lines.speaker: Jace
lines.text: Hello. What can I do for you?

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: I need to ask you a few questions about Mr. Evan.

lines.speaker: Jace
lines.text: I'm very sorry about Jace's death. Someone as good as him shouldn't have met such an end.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: Has Mr. Evan had any conflicts with anyone recently?

lines.speaker: Jace
lines.text: No. He was a good man. It would be difficult for him to have a conflict with anyone.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: I see. Where were you around 7:30 PM, when the murder occurred?

lines.speaker: Jace
lines.text: I was delivering my last package at the shopping district.

lines.speaker: Jace
lines.text: The rain was extremely heavy, so I decided to head back early.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: I see. Did you often meet Mr. Evan?

lines.speaker: Jace
lines.text: Mr. Evan was one of my customers. I've delivered packages to him many times.

lines.speaker: Kael
lines.text: Then you must be quite familiar with his schedule.

lines.speaker: Jace
lines.text: I didn't really pay much attention to his habits.
